s: Din hazkarat haruach vegeshem vetal ubo y"a seipim: beraka sheniyya enah potachat be"baruk", mippene shehi semuka lachabertah. Veken kol berakot haacherot hen semukot zo lazo, laken hen chotemot be"baruk" veen potechot be"baruk". Umatchilin lehazkir haggeshem bibraka sheniyya bitpillat musap shel shemini atzeret, veen poseqin ad tepillat musap shel yom tob harishon shel pesach. Vehazkara zo hi ritztzuy sheela, shetterem sheyyishalu haggeshamim beonatam kesheyyaggia zeman hashsheela — meratztzin lepanayv behazkarat geburotayv shemmorid geshamim. Veqabeu hazkara zo bebirkat "mechayyeh hammetim", mippene shehaggeshamim hem shequlim kitchiyyat hammetim, shekkeshem shettechiyyat hammetim chayyim laolam — kak haggeshamim chayyim laolam. Vehaya min haddin lehazkir uleratztzot lepanayv miyyom tob harishon shel chag, shebbechag niddonim al hammayim, ella lepi shehaggeshamim hem siman qelala bechag hassukkot shei epshar lesheb bassukka bishat haggeshem — en mazkirin haggeshem ad abor z' yeme yeshiba bassukka. Verauy haya lehatchil lehazkir miyyad belel yom tob haacharon, ella lepi shebbitpillat arbit en kol haam bebet hakkeneset — nimtza zeh mazkir vezeh eno mazkir veyeasu aguddot aguddot. Velamma en mazkirin beshacharit? Lepi sheasur lehazkir haggeshem ad sheyyakriz hashsheliach tzibbur o hashshammash beqol ram "morid haggeshem" qodem hattepilla, ubeshacharit i epshar lehakriz mippene shetztzarik lismok geulla litpilla. Lepikak ap mi shehu choleh o anus shemmuttar lo lehaqdim tepillato litpillat hatztzibbur apillu bebet hakkeneset bishar yemot hashshana kemo shennitbaer besiman tz' — asur lo lehaqdim tepillat musap shel shemini atzeret litpillat hatztzibbur apillu bebeto, lepi sheasur lehazkir haggeshem ad sheyyakrizu betzibbur. Abal im yodea shehikrizu betzibbur ap al pi shehu lo shama — mazkir. Umittaam zeh habba lebet hakkeneset vehatztzibbur hitchilu lehitpallel — yitpallel veyazkir ap al pi shehu lo shama keshehikrizu. Vehaddar bemaqom sheen minyan — yamtin ad zeman shemmitpalelim baqqehillot:

Veken leinyan hapsaqa, en poseqin millehazkir ad shemmakrizin bebet hakkeneset "morid hattal" qodem tepillat musap yom tob harishon shel pesach, bimqomot shennohagin lomar "morid hattal" bimqom "morid haggeshem" bimot hachamma, shehakrazat hattal siman hu lahem lehapsaqat hazkarat haggeshem, veqodem hakraza zo en hatztzibbur mapsiqin millehazkir haggeshem, kede shello yihyeh dabar meorab benehem shezzeh mazkir vezeh eno mazkir veyihyeh aguddot aguddot. Abal hayyachid shemmitpallel beno leben atzmo — rashshay lehazkir hattal bimqom geshem. Ubimdinot ellu (sheen nohagin lehazkir tal bimot hachamma bimqom haggeshem veen hakrazat tal siman kelal lehapsaqat hazkarat geshem) nohagin shello lehapsiq millehazkir geshem ad tepillat hammincha sheshshameu kebar mishsheliach tzibbur sheppasaq bitpillat musap, abal bitpillat musap kol haqqahal vegam hashsheliach tzibbur mazkirin haggeshem bitpillat lachash, kede shello yihyeh dabar meorab ben hatztzibbur, shei epshar lehakriz qodem hattepilla sheyyapsiqu millehazkir haggeshem mippene shennireh kimemaanim bigshamim, al derek sheameru: en mitpalelin al rob toba. Umah sheen hashsheliach tzibbur poseq bitpillat hashshachar hu mishshum otam shello hayu bebet hakkeneset bearbit, ukesheyyishmeu shehashsheliach tzibbur eno mazkir beshacharit yisberu shemmapsiqin millehazkir bitpillat arbit, shehayyom holek achar hallayla bekol maqom, velashshana habbaa lo yazkiru bearbit, venimtza zeh mazkir vezeh eno mazkir:

Battal ubaruchot lo chiyyebu chakamim lehazkir, lo bahazkara shebbebirkat mechayyeh hammetim velo bashsheela shebbebirkat hashshanim, mippene sheenan netzarim leolam. Veim ba lehazkir — mazkir. Venohagin bekol hammeqomot lomar "mashshib haruach" bahazkara bimot haggeshamim, veen mazkirin et haruach bashsheela. Abal bimot hachamma en mazkirin oto kelal, mippene sheeno mitbaqqesh ella bimot haggeshamim kede lenaggeb lachut haaretz shehu merubbeh. Veim lo hizkiro bimot haggeshamim, o shehizkiro bimot hachamma — en machazirin oto, apillu lo siyyem adayin habberaka. Vehattal shehu dabar hammitbaqqesh leolam — yesh meqomot shennohagin lehazkiro bimot hachamma velishol oto ben bimot hachamma ben bimot haggeshamim, sheap sheen netzar leolam mikkol maqom mebaqshim sheyyihyeh libraka, shellipamim eno libraka. Veim hizkiro bimot haggeshamim, o shello hizkiro bimot hachamma, o shello shaal oto ben bimot hachamma ben bimot haggeshamim — en machazirin oto apillu lo siyyem adayin habberaka, meachar shello chiyyebu chakamim kelal lehazkir battal ubaruchot. Ubimdinot ellu nohagim lishol hattal bimot haggeshamim velo bimot hachamma, velo lehazkiro lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim. Veim hizkiro veshaal oto — en machazirin oto (kegon sheamar "veten tal" venizkar qodem sheamar "umatar"):

Im amar "morid haggeshem" bimot hachamma — machazirin oto, lepi shehaggeshamim bimot hachamma enam ella siman qelala, laken hitzriku lazeh shehizkir qelala bitpillato sheyyachazor veyitpallel belo qelala otah beraka shehizkir bah qelala. Lepikak hu tzarik lachazor lerosh habberaka, sheim yachazor li"mekalkel chayyim" — lo yebattel bazeh mah shehizkir shello kaddin, shekken dinah shel hazkara bimot haggeshamim lomar "mekalkel chayyim" achar "morid haggeshem". Veim nizkar achar chatimat habberaka — tzarik lachazor lerosh hattepilla, lepi shekkol hattoeh beezo beraka beinyan shetztzarik lachazor uletaqqen tauto velo chazar ad shechatam beraka zo — lo day lo sheyyachazor lammaqom shettaa letaqqen tauto, ella tzarik lachazor lerosh habberaka kemo sheyyitbaer, veg' berakot rishonot chashubot kibraka achat kemo sheyyitbaer:

Vaapillu bizman shehaggeshem eno siman qelala, kegon shello yatza adayin nisan shel chamma, vaapillu im tzerikim ligshamim — machazirim oto, shekkevan sherob hazzeman shepposeqin millehazkir geshem haggeshem bo siman qelala, lo chillequ chakamim veameru shemmishshaa shepposeqim millehazkir im hizkir — machazirin oto. Vaapillu baaratzot shelleolam hen tzerikot ligshamim bimot hachamma, beinyan sheim shaal bahen geshamim bimot hachamma be"birkat hashshanim" en machazirin oto kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qy"z, mikkol maqom im hizkir bahen geshem bi"techiyyat hammetim" — machazirin oto, shetztzorek aratzot ligshamim eno inyan lehazkara ella lishela (shebbashsheela hu mebaqqesh al artzo, abal bahazkara hu meshabbeach lehaqqadosh baruk hu shehu morid geshamim shello beittam shehem siman qelala leeretz yisrael vekayyotze bah, laken tzarik lachazor velomar otah beraka belo qelala):

Bimot haggeshamim im lo amar "morid haggeshem" (apillu amar "mashshib haruach") — machazirin oto. Vehu shello hizkir tal, abal im hizkir tal — en machazirin oto (apillu lo siyyem habberaka), sheap shehattal eno netzar mikkol maqom shebach hu lehaqqadosh baruk hu behazkarato kemo behazkarat haggeshem, shekkeshem shehaggeshamim chayyim laolam kak hattal hu chayyim laolam, sheal yede kak mitbareket hattebua (ubekamma meqomot qareu chakamim lehattal "tal techiyya", mah sheen ken haruach sheap shei epshar laolam belo ruchot —eno niqra chayyim laolam kemo geshem vetal. Lekak yesh bene adam shemmazkirin hattal kol yemot hachamma, kede sheim yishkechu lomar "morid haggeshem" bimot haggeshamim — chazaqa sheameru "morid hattal" kemo shehem regilim bimot hachamma, veen machazirin otan):

Bammeh debarim amurim shemmachazirin oto im lo hizkir geshem velo tal bimot haggeshamim, keshessiyyem kol habberaka vehitchil beraka shelleachareha veaz chozer lerosh hattepilla mittaam shennitbaer lemala, abal im nizkar qodem shessiyyem habberaka — yomar "mashshib haruach" u"morid haggeshem" bammaqom shennizkar, shello qabeu chakamim maqom betok habberaka lehazkir sham haggeshem, ella ameru setam: mazkirin geburot geshamim bitchiyyat hammetim, ella shennahagu leomro lipne "mekalkel chayyim" lepi shehaggeshem kalkala uparnasa, abal im lo amaro lipne "mekalkel chayyim" — bekol habberaka meqomah. Vaapillu im siyyem habberaka venizkar qodem shehitchil "atta qadosh" — en tzarik lachazor larosh, ella yomar "mashshib haruach umorid haggeshem" belo chatima veshub omer "atta qadosh", shekkol shello hitchil babberaka shelleachareha — lo niqra siyyum beraka zo legamre leinyan debarim shemmachazirin oto, ap al pi shenniqra siyyum leinyan debarim sheen machazirin oto, kegon habdala be"chonen haddaat" ve"yaaleh veyabo" bearbit rosh chodesh, sheen leomram keshessiyyem habberaka ap al pi shello hitchil beraka shelleachareha, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rtz"d vetak"b:

G' berakot rishonot chashubot keachat, hoil veinyanam echad lesadder shibcho shel maqom qodem sheelot tzerakayv, keebed shemmesadder shebach lipne rabbo qodem shemmebaqqesh peras mimmennu, veken g' acharonot chashubot keachat, shehen keebed sheqqibbel peras merabbo veniptar veholek lo, kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"b. Lepikak, bekol maqom shettaa beg' rishonot — chozer lerosh hattepilla, ubeg' acharonot — chozer laaboda, ben shehu yachid ben tzibbur, im hu taut shei epshar letaqqeno ella im ken yachazor lerosh habberaka shettaa bah, kegon shettaa bachatimatah shechatam bibraka zo beinyan beraka acheret, o shechatam "hael haqqadosh" baaseret yeme teshuba velo nizkar ad leachar kede dibbur, shei epshar lo letaqqen tauto al yede sheyyachazor veyachtom kahogen, sheen chazara moelet ella betok kede dibbur. Vekayyotze bazeh bibrakot emtzaiyyot — tzarik lachazor lerosh beraka zo. Vehu haddin im chatam kahogen ella (shekkol nussach habberaka ad hachatima amar nussach acher shello keinyan beraka zo kelal velo nizkar ad leachar shechatam) (o shello amar shum nussach techilla raq hachatima bilbaddah shennimtza) shello amar beraka zo ella bematbea qatzar, kebirkat happerot vehammitzvot sheppetichatan hi chatimatan, veshinna mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim bibrakot — lo yatza yede chobato, vetzarik lachazor lerosh beraka zo im hi mibberakot emtzaiyyot, ubeg' rishonot tzarik lachazor larosh, ubeg' acharonot laaboda (veen tzarik lomar im dilleg beraka achat legamre velo nizkar ad achar chatimat beraka sheachareha), sheim lo ken kesheyyomar bammaqom shennizkar — have leh hashsheniyya ketaut baemtza. Abal im dilleg beemtzaah (vaapillu amar bimqom haddillug nussach acher sheeno meen beraka zo), kol shechatam kahogen (veamar qodem hachatima ezo baqqasha keinyan beraka zo vaamarah belashon meshunneh mittiqqun chakamim) — eno niqra meshanneh mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim bibrakot, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"v ves"ch, sheeno niqra meshanneh mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim ella keshemmeshanneh biptichatan o bachatimatan bibrakot shechotemot be"baruk" upotechot be"baruk" [(]ubirkot y"ch shechotemot be"baruk" veenan potechot be"baruk", ap im shinna petichatah vaamarah belashon acher beinyan habberaka — dino keillu shinna beemtza beraka, shehare hen berakot hassemukot zo lazo vekol petichatah hi kemo emtza beraka):

Kol maqom sheameru chozer labberaka shettaa bah, kegon sheddilleg, o taa bachatimat berakot emtzaiyyot, o beg' acharonot shechozer laaboda shehi reshitan, o shehizkir haggeshem bimot hachamma shechozer lerosh beraka sheniyya im lo siyyem habberaka — hakkol lo ameru ella keshettaa beshogeg, abal bemezid umitkavven — tzarik lachazor lerosh hattepilla. Vehu haddin im sach bemezid kemo shennitbaer besiman q"d:

Hammitpallel veeno yodea im hizkir haggeshem im lav — ad sheloshim yom chazaqa mah shehu lamud hu mazkir, mikkan veelak mah shehu tzarik hu mazkir. Lepikak, im mesuppaq bimot hachamma im hizkir "morid haggeshem" — ad sheloshim yom bechezqat shehizkiro kemo shehaya ragil kol yemot hachorep vetzarik lachazor. Ubimot haggeshamim tzarik gam ken lachazor ad sheloshim yom — bimdinot ellu sheen mazkirin tal bimot hachamma, vahare kol sheloshim yom hu bechezqat shello hizkir lo tal velo geshamim — min hassetam. Leachar l' yom en tzarik lachazor, shekkebar nitraggel leshono lomar kahalaka umin hassetam amar kehergel leshono. Vaapillu im shagag o pasha yom o yomayim velo hitpallel kelal — lo hura chezqato bazeh, vekevan shehuchzaq berob ellu yamim — dayyo bekak, shekkevan sheachar shello hizkir ezeh yom chazar achar kak vehizkir ad tom l' yom — hare zeh bachazaqa shel l' yom:

Im bayyom harishon shel pesach omer birkat "atta gibbor" ad "morid hattal" vead biklal, o bimdinot ellu ad "mekalkel chayyim" vead biklal, belo "morid haggeshem" tz' peamim — hare nitraggel leshono lomar (ve)"rab lehoshia" (u)"morid hattal" o (ve)"rab lehoshia mekalkel chayyim", keillu amar ken l' yom, shebbel' yom mimot hachol gam ken eno omer ella tz' peamim, g' peamim bekol yom, veim hurgal kesheomer mepuzzarin — qal vachomer birtzupin. Lepikak, im achar kak eno zoker im hizkir haggeshem — chazaqa shello hizkiro veen tzarik lachazor. Veken im bishmini atzeret omer tz' peamim "atta gibbor" ad u"morid haggeshem" vead biklal veachar kak nistappeq im hizkir haggeshem — chazaqa shehizkiro (veyesh choleqin al zeh. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla, shello laasot ken lismok al zeh. Abal im asa ken veachar kak nistappeq im hizkiro — en tzarik lachazor, ki ken iqqar):
